entities.summary: The Saint Sava Serbian Orthodox Monastery and Seminary is an Eastern Orthodox Christian and professional school of theology located in Libertyville, Illinois. It is under jurisdiction of the Serbian Orthodox Eparchy of New Gračanica and Midwestern America of the Serbian Orthodox Church. The monastery is listed on the National Register of Historic Places. The seminary is a collocated facility with the monastery and possesses a library of 8,000 titles. There is also a cemetery on the property.
